# Third-party renderer references

Store inputs paired with another renderer's output. Initial candidates are
inkterop's PNG and normalized PDF-operation goldens, covering pen families,
colours, landscape orientation, highlighters, and extended pages.

Pin the renderer revision and settings. Keep these references distinguished from
official tablet exports, even when an upstream author reports validating their
renderer against official output. Record known differences rather than treating
agreement as proof of tablet fidelity.

See the [source catalog and attribution requirements](../../README.md).
